**Description & Requirements**
The Manager, Employer Branding & Recruiting (FTC 24 months) will work closely with the German and Regional Practice Group leads, EMEA Business Managers and recruitment coordinators as well as Center-based services to deliver a first-class recruitment experience to all Fee Earner and Early Careers candidates (split by practice group) and Hiring Managers.
  
  
The individual will also be responsible of the execution of full life-cycle recruitment processes (internal and external) to fill role vacancies, leveraging regional and global resources whilst delivering significant hiring numbers in a hands-on and direct sourcing capacity.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of the operational execution of end-to-end Fee Earner and Early Careers recruitment, working directly with the Practice Group Business Mangers, including direct sourcing, executing go to market strategy, efficiently managing applications, candidate shortlisting and interviewing, working with hiring managers and office leaders to agree and deliver best practice process and interviews, offer management and pre-onboarding activity, ensuring a seamless transition to Talent colleagues for onboarding
* Lead, coach, and develop the German Recruitment team (2 Managers), fostering a high-performance culture
* Work with the EMEA Early Careers Senior Manager to design and implementation of the German Graduate Recruitment marketing, attraction and media strategy
* Manage all aspects of the Early Careers events programs, including faculty career days, moot court/study foundation and legal tech events
* Manage, with the team, the complicated Early Careers application and selection process, including pre-selection, the application process, offers and onboarding
* Manage employer branding and digital strategy specific to the local market, while maintaining global brand consistency
* Supporting the junior lawyer population throughout the employee lifecycle and proactively lead on and manage all HR related areas for the population.
* Develop strong business relationships with practice group leadership that is underpinned by solid specialist knowledge of both German/EMEA markets and legal recruitment - be a subject matter expert
* Maintain a consistent high-quality pipeline of passive and interested inclusive and diverse talent
* Partner with and ensure effective collaboration and communication with practice group leadership and in-market Talent teams to drive best-in-class recruitment and functional cohesiveness
* Work with the Regional Director and Associate Director of Recruitment to continuously improve and implement effective recruitment strategies and processes to ensure sourcing/hiring best practices are implemented and followed across the German offices
* Work with the Regional Director and Associate Director of Recruitment to deliver timely and accurate reporting of all related recruitment activities and use data to drive recruitment performance and track FTE headcount
* Execute recruitment strategies that drive creative sourcing methodologies and reduce dependency on agencies
* Maintain a continuous focus on our ID&E strategy and ensuring inclusive recruitment practices at all times
* Where vendors are used, adhere to preferred supplier strategy to ensure optimal vendor performance and appropriate pricing
* Ensure that all recruitment processes support the Firm's brand and that the Firm provides a world-class candidate experience throughout the selection process
* Ensure adherence to Hiring Committee and budgeting/approvals process at all times
* Developing new and creative strategies in recruiting and employer branding, as well as supporting projects aimed at optimizing recruiting processes

**Function**
The Firm's People function has responsibility for recruiting, supporting and developing all of the Firm's people, including our Partners, Lawyers and Business Professionals, working closely with the Firm's leadership to design and deliver the Firm's people strategy, building on the firm's core commitments to collaboration, excellence and inclusivity. The function includes:
  
  

* Talent Management
* Recruitment & Mobility
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Leadership & Learning
* Careers & Performance
* Partner Services and
* Rewards

**Technical Skills, Qualifications And Experience**

* A completed degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) or a comparable qualification
* Experience of running significant strategic recruitment in a complex global professional services organization, ideally a law firm
* Extensive experience in delivering Fee Earner and Early Careers recruitment within a German legal services environment
* Strong track record in direct sourcing methodologies and delivery of high quality, diverse talent
* Strong collaborative working style and track record of building deep relationships with senior stakeholders and establishing trusted advisor status
* Able to work at pace, problem solve and deliver solutions against tight timelines under pressure
* Excellent communication skills with both team members and senior and executive stakeholders
* Able to bring good judgement and empathy to sensitive situations
* Strong team spirit, reliability, flexibility, and commitment
* Analytical skills, along with an independent and proactive way of working
* A friendly, service-oriented attitude and a hands-on mindset
* Creativity, ambition, and the motivation to contribute your own ideas, get involved in international projects early on, and engage with innovative HR concepts
* Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

**Personal Qualities**
Know how:
  
  

* Keeps across key developments in all relevant areas and demonstrates the ability to develop substantive authority in relation to the Firm's specialist fields
* Demonstrates the ability to identify the real issue, and to anticipate requirements and potential consequences; distils a range of possibilities by thinking in a considered, prudent manner
* Able to move through a variety of tasks requiring different approaches, knowledge, and expertise, with agility of mind and capacity for analysis and synthesis

**Dedication**

* Driven by a strong personal sense of integrity and upholds exemplary quality standards
* Prepares thoroughly, takes responsibility, uses initiative and is self-reliant to ensure work progresses to the fullest extent possible
* Hardworking and diligent with a keen understanding of client demands
* Demonstrates composure when dealing with difficult situations

**Personal Impact**

* Creates a positive impression at all times; develops relationships through collaboration and reciprocity
* Negotiates to achieve outcomes that are mutually satisfactory; shows good judgement on when to stand strong and when to compromise
* Invests in, nurtures and builds a network of productive relationships

**Humanity**

* Respectful to others, regardless of their position, and earns the respect of others by being transparent
* Has care and concern for others and a genuine interest in others as people
* Treats delicate or confidential issues with grace and discretion

**About Us**
At Baker McKenzie we are different in the way we think, work and behave. With our team of 13,000 people, including over 6,500 locally admitted lawyers, in over 70 offices worldwide, we have a passionately collaborative community of 60 nationalities and are committed to world-class career development to everyone in every job at every level. Baker McKenzie can offer you both the uncompromising commitment to excellence expected of a top firm paired with a passionately global and genuinely collaborative working environment.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Baker McKenzie is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion for all. Our unique international culture is reflected in the drawing together of a worldwide family of individuals from diverse cultures and backgrounds in all of our offices. We encourage the best people - regardless of race, religion or belief if any, gender, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation or age - to fulfill their professional aspirations with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates.

title: Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition
description:
About Pointo

Pointo is building a large-scale, closed-loop battery supply chain focused on EV battery distribution, leasing, servicing, and lifecycle management. As the business expands across markets and functions, timely access to the right talent is critical to revenue generation, operational continuity, and growth.

Role Overview

The Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition will manage end-to-end recruitment across technical and non-technical functions, including technology, product, data, Sales, Collections, Field Operations, Hub Operations, and corporate roles. The role requires a hands-on recruiter who can deliver against aggressive hiring targets, manage multiple urgent requisitions, build sourcing pipelines, and maintain accurate recruitment reporting.

This is an execution-heavy role with direct accountability for recruitment progress and joining outcomes. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at pace, handling demanding stakeholders, and taking ownership of hiring challenges from requisition intake through joining.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Recruitment

·       Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle: requirement intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer management, and joining follow-up.

·       Manage multiple concurrent requisitions across technical, business, frontline, managerial, and specialized roles.

·       Prioritize critical and revenue-linked positions in line with approved manpower requirements and business urgency.

·       Maintain active candidate pipelines for recurring, high-volume, and hard-to-fill positions.

·       Ensure recruitment activity is tracked consistently from requisition opening through candidate joining.

2. Technical Talent Acquisition

·       Drive recruitment for software engineering, backend and frontend development, mobile applications, QA/testing, DevOps, IT, data analytics, database, product, and other technology roles as required.

·       Interpret technical job descriptions, required technology stacks, experience levels, and role-specific competencies to support effective screening.

·       Partner with technical hiring managers to calibrate candidate profiles, shortlist quality, interview stages, and selection criteria.

·       Use targeted sourcing through Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, technology communities, direct outreach, and specialist vendors where appropriate.

·       Manage technical hiring challenges including niche skill availability, compensation expectations, competing offers, notice periods, and candidate dropouts.

·       Maintain candidate engagement and timely follow-up through technical interview stages, offer release, and joining.

3. Business and Frontline Hiring

·       Manage recruitment across Sales, Collections, Field Operations, Customer Support, Hub Operations, and corporate functions.

·       Execute high-volume, multi-location hiring aligned with business expansion and operational requirements.

·       Develop location-specific sourcing strategies for difficult markets and recurring frontline roles.

·       Coordinate with hiring managers to accelerate shortlisting, interview feedback, and final decisions.

4. Stakeholder Management

·       Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, priority, compensation range, and expected joining timelines.

·       Drive timely feedback and decision-making through structured follow-ups and clear escalation of delays.

·       Communicate recruitment progress, risks, sourcing challenges, and expected closure dates transparently.

·       Handle demanding stakeholders professionally while maintaining focus on agreed hiring outcomes.

5. Sourcing Strategy and Candidate Conversion

·       Use Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment vendors, direct sourcing, and other relevant channels.

·       Build and maintain talent pools for recurring, critical, technical, and location-specific roles.

·       Track source effectiveness and recruitment funnel conversion to improve sourcing quality.

·       Manage compensation discussions and candidate expectations within approved salary structures.

·       Monitor offer acceptance, counteroffers, notice periods, and non-joining reasons; take proactive steps to improve joining conversion.

6. Recruitment MIS, Analytics and Governance

·       Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and dashboards covering total requisitions, open, on-hold, offered, joined, revoked/cancelled, and pending positions.

·       Track Time-to-Hire, offer-to-joining conversion, joining achievement, funnel conversion, source effectiveness, and recruiter productivity.

·       Prepare daily updates as needed and weekly/monthly recruitment reports for management review.

·       Identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions based on recruitment data.

·       Ensure recruitment records, interview feedback, approvals, and candidate documentation are maintained in line with internal processes.

7. Process Improvement and Coordination

·       Follow established recruitment SOPs, approval matrices, and compensation approval processes.

·       Coordinate with HR Operations for a smooth handover of confirmed joiners and pre-joining requirements.

·       Coordinate with recruitment executives and external vendors, where applicable, to maintain hiring momentum.

·       Recommend practical improvements to sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, reporting, and joining processes.

Work Environment and Expectations

Pointo is a fast-paced, execution-focused business where manpower availability can directly affect revenue generation, market expansion, and operational continuity. Recruitment priorities may shift quickly as business needs evolve. This role is best suited to someone who is energized by measurable goals, rapid execution, and solving hiring challenges.

·       High-pressure, target-driven environment: work toward clearly defined hiring and joining goals with regular performance reviews.

·       Strong sense of urgency: respond quickly to changing priorities and keep critical requisitions moving.

·       End-to-end ownership: remain accountable for progress from requirement intake through joining, rather than limiting involvement to sourcing or interview scheduling.

·       Multiple priorities: manage several vacancies and locations simultaneously while maintaining candidate quality and data accuracy.

·       Stakeholder intensity: handle demanding business managers with professional communication, persistence, and constructive escalation.

·       Resilience and adaptability: remain composed and productive when hiring targets are challenging, candidate pipelines are limited, or priorities change.

·       Performance transparency: use accurate data to communicate progress, identify gaps, and take corrective action.

This is not a passive recruitment coordination role. It requires a hands-on professional who can take initiative, challenge bottlenecks constructively, and consistently work toward agreed business outcomes. High standards of professionalism, respectful communication, and responsible working practices are expected alongside urgency and accountability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·       Achievement of assigned hiring and joining targets against approved manpower plans.

·       Time-to-Hire and adherence to agreed recruitment timelines.

·       Offer-to-joining conversion and reduction in candidate dropouts.

·       Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates.

·       Effectiveness in closing critical, technical, and high-volume requisitions.

·       Recruitment funnel conversion and sourcing channel effectiveness.

·       Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment MIS and dashboards.

·       Hiring manager responsiveness and stakeholder satisfaction.

·       Compliance with recruitment approvals, documentation, and process standards.

Specific monthly targets and service-level timelines will be agreed based on requisition volume, role complexity, location, and business priority.

Qualifications and Experience

·       MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification preferred.

·       Typically 3–5 years of hands-on Talent Acquisition experience.

·       Demonstrable exposure to technical hiring for software engineering, product, IT, data, or related technology roles.

·       Experience in high-volume Sales, Collections, Field Operations, or other frontline recruitment is strongly preferred.

·       Experience managing multi-location hiring and working directly with business stakeholders.

·       Hands-on proficiency in Naukri, LinkedIn, Excel, recruitment trackers, and HRMS/ATS tools.

Core Competencies

·       Strong sourcing, screening, and candidate assessment skills.

·       Ability to understand technical job descriptions and screen for relevant skills and experience.

·       Excellent follow-up discipline, negotiation, and candidate engagement.

·       Data-driven approach to recruitment planning, funnel analysis, and reporting.

·       Prioritization, problem-solving, and execution under pressure.

·       Professional communication, stakeholder management, resilience, and accountability.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has worked in a startup, fintech, EV, automotive, mobility, SaaS, logistics, or another high-growth business where recruitment delivery is closely linked to business performance. They can switch between specialized technical hiring and high-volume business recruitment, operate independently, and communicate hiring risks early.

Candidates seeking a predictable, low-pressure recruitment coordination role with limited ownership may not find this position suitable.

title: Career Process Association - Night Shift -US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Career Process Associate – Night Shift – US Process will work full time on\-site at the Rajarhat office. This role involves supporting candidates through the career process, including understanding their profiles, discussing career paths, and guiding them through application, interview, and onboarding stages. The associate will handle inbound and outbound communication with candidates and clients in the US, provide timely information, and ensure a professional and positive experience. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, analyzing candidate fit for roles, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering high\-quality customer service during night shift hours. The role also requires adherence to company policies, process guidelines, and performance targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Career Counseling and Career Development skills to guide individuals through role selection and growth opportunities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication abilities, including clear spoken and written English suitable for US\-based clients and candidates.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess candidate profiles, match them with suitable roles, and interpret process\-related data.
* Candidates should possess proven Customer Service skills to manage queries, resolve issues, and maintain a positive experience throughout the staffing process.

* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.
